## Summary
Applied Data Scientist specializing in high-throughput biological data and production analytics systems with extensive experience designing end-to-end data workflows, developing custom R packages, and building cloud-backed applications. Skilled in Python, SQL, AWS, and statistical modeling, with a strong foundation in experimental design and high-throughput data. Proven track record of optimizing data analysis pipelines, improving lab efficiency, and delivering actionable insights to drive research and operational success.

## Experience
### Lead Data Scientist -- Priogen Corp.
**Jan 2024 -- present**

- Architected and deployed end-to-end data analysis pipelines to process high-throughput diagnostic datasets (up to 100 samples/week, ~240k rows of time-series data/project), reducing analysis time from ~4 hours to seconds.
- Led full-stack development of a Python-based LIMS (PriLIMS) using Django, automating client data intake, tracking, and reporting, eliminating 10 hours/week of manual administrative work.
- Implemented cloud-based infrastructure on AWS to support scalable SQL storage and analysis, improving system reliability and enabling secure multi-user access.
- Introduced Git-based version control and CI workflows across projects, improving collaboration efficiency and significantly reducing deployment errors.

### Researcher IV -- University of Minnesota
**Aug 2019 -- present**

- Developed a custom R package and automation scripts to standardize RT-QuIC data analysis, reducing hours of analysis time to seconds and increasing reproducibility across collaborating labs.
- Streamlined data processing and reporting workflows using R and Python tools, reducing turnaround time for experimental results by 99%.
- Built and evaluated statistical models to classify diagnostic outcomes, improving disease detection confidence.
- Standardized cross-lab analytics and built reusable analytical frameworks adopted by multiple institutions.
- Led laboratory establishment, expansion, and workflow redesign, increasing research capacity.
